heroHeadline: Day 810: Ten Killed in Sinaloa in One Day as Mazatlán Remains Epicenter
heroSubtitle: Preliminary data cite 10 homicides on October 11, at least seven in Mazatlán, after seven on October 6; Noroeste counts 3,963 homicides since September 2024.
